Read the activity manifest from a Strava export

Source: R/dashboard.R
load_activities_csv.Rd

Reads activities.csv from the repository root and returns a tidy manifest, newest first. The stem column is the activity's stream file name with all extensions stripped, which is the key linking a manifest row to its Parquet and HTML files. It is NA for manual activities that have no stream file.

Usage

load_activities_csv(repo = here("strava_repo"))

Arguments

repo

Path to the Strava repository.

Value

A tibble with one row per activity, sorted newest first.
